lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Everyone, listen up.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: There are a total of four events scheduled next week:

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Monday: Royal Road charity function

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Tuesday: Talentum VIP event

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Thursday: Central Government high-ranking officials fellowship gathering

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Saturday: M.M.R. energy sector performance conference

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Don't forget, and make sure you're well prepared.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: Aw man,

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: I'm not even gonna have time to watch any movies next week.

lines.speaker: anchor
lines.text: No way...
That's a packed schedule.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Nothing we can do about that.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: In order to raise enough money to maintain the Admire,

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: we have no choice but to accept all the reservations that come our way.
I'm surprised to see Talentum on the list.
Why would M.M.R. hold a conference here of all places?
I'd have reservations about hosting a government function filled with the top brass.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Hm.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: The Admire is one of the most luxurious venues

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: in the Ark where you can host a gathering.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: They often make reservations here

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: to give their guests the full VIP treatment.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: The guests have always spoken highly of the events held here.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Beats me.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Their researchers could be under a lot of stress,

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: and the company has plenty of money to throw around,

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: so they don't mind splurging a bit.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: The fact that they're holding a supposedly work-based event on the weekend

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: tells me they don't intend on actually getting much work done.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: We'll have to play it by ear.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Even within the Central Government itself, there are various subdivisions of official and unofficial factions.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: You should listen to the conversations they have as they're making their toasts.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: People's entire lives are being made or broken on a whim.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: I try to keep my distance,

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: but we're in desperate need of donations, so my hands are tied.

lines.speaker: anchor
lines.text: Ugh!

lines.speaker: anchor
lines.text: There are too many events.

lines.speaker: anchor
lines.text: We need more people on staff.

lines.speaker: anchor
lines.text: Why can't we recruit more squad members? @Helm

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: Keep dreaming.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: We're already barely keeping our heads above water.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: If we expanded the team,

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: we'd have to factor in additional costs for their room and board, and any potential repairs.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: I'm inclined to agree.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Unless it's someone who could really benefit the team,

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: it simply wouldn't be worth the additional expenses.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Wait a second...

lines.speaker: anchor
lines.text: Are you all...

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: Thinking what I'm thinking?

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: We've got the perfect candidate right in front of us.

lines.speaker: anchor
lines.text: I just remembered as well:

lines.speaker: anchor
lines.text: you've got a decent chunk of free time

lines.speaker: anchor
lines.text: until your next assignment, isn't that right Captain?

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: Oooh!

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: It's like it's meant to be!
Hold on a second.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: I hate to recruit someone

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: who is set to have some vacation time,

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: but I think you coming here

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: would really boost morale.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Do you think you could stop by sometime next week?

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: It doesn't matter which day.

lines.speaker: anchor
lines.text: Captain!

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: Captain!!

lines.speaker: anchor
lines.text: Helm: Subordinate!!!
... Fine.

lines.speaker: anchor
lines.text: We did it!
But I'm telling you, I really can't on Thursday.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Thursday?

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: Thursday: Central Government high-ranking officials fellowship gathering

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: You mean this day?

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Ah,

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: understood.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: We're already asking a lot of you to help us out.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: To have you do menial labor in front of your superiors is a big ask.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Very well, then if you could come on any of the other three days, it'd be greatly appreciated.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: I should also mention that

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: we wouldn't ask you to do this without some kind of remuneration.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: The quality of the food served at these events is exceptional.
Then I'll be sure to attend.
If possible, I should try to go to Talentum's event, since there will at least be some familiar faces.
